gloss: to cut out, to pull through

definitions.explanation: To cut something out from paper, fabric, or other material.

definitions.gloss: to pull through, to get through, to survive
definitions.explanation: To overcome a difficult situation or crisis through perseverance.

examples.japanese: {新聞|しんぶん}の{記事|きじ}を{切|き}り{抜|ぬ}いた。
examples.english: I clipped out a newspaper article.

examples.japanese: {困難|こんなん}を{切|き}り{抜|ぬ}けた。
なんとかこの{危機|きき}を{切|き}り{抜|ぬ}こう。
examples.english: Let's somehow get through this crisis.

notes:
TRANSITIVITY: {他動詞|たどうし} (transitive). Compound verb: {切|き}る + {抜|ぬ}く. Pattern: Xを{切|き}り{抜|ぬ}く (cut out X / get through X).

ASPECT: ている indicates resulting state. {切|き}り{抜|ぬ}いている = 'has cut out' or 'has survived.'

COMMON PATTERNS:
・{写真|しゃしん}を{切|き}り{抜|ぬ}く (cut out a photo)
・{困難|こんなん}を{切|き}り{抜|ぬ}く (pull through difficulties)
・{切|き}り{抜|ぬ}き (clipping; noun form)

MODERN USAGE: 「{切|き}り{抜|ぬ}き{動画|どうが}」 refers to video clips extracted from longer content, popular on social media.

NOTE: Sometimes written/pronounced as {切|き}り{抜|ぬ}ける (ichidan) with similar meaning for sense 2.
